name: Hollow Earth
author: FileExplorerExe
description: Note: The secret way starts at 43% if you don't skip the intro. Fall above the spider orbs as the ufo at 34% and then click once or twice to land on the following platform and fall above the level. Spam at 38% until you can see your icon. At 70%, start moving down to be able to play through the gameplay as the UFO at 80%. Go between the spider portal and the saw at 81%. Play through the section as a ufo until 83%, where you'll need to fall back above the level after the saw. Stay above the level until the end from there.
